auto_detect.label: Find Keyboards Automatically
auto_detect.description: Reads every keyboard listed in /proc/bus/input/devices, including the virtual one a remapper like keyd creates, and rescans every 5 seconds. Turn off to use only the devices listed below.

input_devices.description: 优先使用 /dev/input/by-id/*-event-* 或 /dev/input/by-path/*-event-*；内核或设备更新后，/dev/input/eventN 可能会发生变化
input_devices.label: 输入设备

show_wpm.description: Shows your typing speed next to the cat while you type, and hides it again 5 seconds after you stop. Counts characters only, so modifiers and arrow keys do not add to it.
show_wpm.label: Show Typing Speed
